name: 10% Morphine Solution
description: A morphine solution from low-quality morphine base. The presence of impurities makes it unsuitable for direct use, but it may still be valuable in the hands of experienced medical personnel.

name: Acetic Anhydride
description: A colorless liquid with a strong, pungent odor, commonly used in the production of photographic film and cigarette filters. Its availability is restricted due to its potential for criminal misuse, particularly in the production of gray heroin.

name: Ammonium Chloride
description: An inorganic compound commonly used as a fertilizer for crops such as rice and wheat. Prolonged application can increase soil acidity, so it should be used with caution. It can also be used in the extraction of morphine from opium.

name: Analog Indicator
description: An analog gauge used to display measured values. Currently, it sits at zero. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Artillery Balistic Calculator
description: A portable yet powerful computer capable of rapidly calculating accurate ballistic solutions for indirect-fire weapons. Contains valuable data on LAF artillery capabilities and electronic components useful for constructing hacking devices.

name: Bromopyridine
description: A halogenated pyridine compound commonly used as a chemical intermediate in the synthesis of more complex organic substances. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: Circuit Board
description: A versatile circuit board with multiple inputs and outputs, as well as microprocessor for basic programming. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Citric Acid
description: An eco-friendly alternative to harsher cleaning chemicals, citric acid is effective at removing mineral buildup, grease, and everyday grime. Its acidic properties also make it useful in the production of morphine solution.

name: Civilian Software
description: A USB drive containing an assortment of civilian software, applications, and other potentially useful data. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: CNC Drill Bits
description: High-precision drill bits made from high-grade steel for exceptional durability and wear resistance. Built to last a lifetime. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Complex Glass Electrode
description: An engineered glass electrode designed to measure ionic activity in liquids. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Counter IED/Jammer Unit
description: A programmable manpack jammer designed to disrupt nearby communication networks and electronic signals. Contains extremely valuable data on LAF electronic warfare capabilities and advanced electronic components useful for constructing hacking devices.

name: CPU
description: A primary processing component of a computer, responsible for executing program instructions and performing calculations. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: CPU Card
description: A CPU card extracted from an LAF artillery computer, providing enough processing power to perform dictionary attacks and generate PIN codes. An essential component for constructing a basic hacking tool.

name: Crystal Prism
description: A precisely calibrated prism that refracts light, allowing it to be separated into its full spectrum. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Digital Synthesis Engine
description: A specialized circuit board capable of generating arbitrary high-frequency analog waveforms with high precision. An essential component for constructing a superior hacking tool.

name: Electronic Warfare Configuration Drive
description: A reinforced external hard drive containing extracted configuration data for electronic warfare systems.

name: Empty Autoinjector
description: An empty autoinjector that can be filled with a variety of medical substances for quick and simple administration. Required for crafting most stimulants

name: Fabrics
description: A roll of durable cloth fabric suitable for insulation, filtration, padding and other practical uses. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Fine Metal Mesh
description: A fine metal mesh ideal for filtration, allowing water to pass through while leaving solid particles behind. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Garden Lime
description: A granular soil conditioner. Its acid-neutralizing properties allow beneficial bacteria to flourish, improving the growth and resilience of crops. It can also be used in the morphine extraction process. Keep out of reach of children.

name: Gray Heroin
description: A highly addictive opioid substance of relatively low purity. Valuable to those with few morals and the right connections on the black market.

name: HEPA Filter
description: A high-efficiency air filter designed to capture fine airborne particles and contaminants. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: High-Quality Morphine Base
description: A highly refined morphine base containing minimal impurities and suitable for advanced pharmaceutical production. Its refined composition makes it ideal for producing high-quality morphine solutions or pure heroin.

name: IMSI Catcher
description: A device that masquerades as a cell tower to intercept and monitor communications from nearby mobile devices. A useful tool for anyone interested in conversation they weren't invited to. Contains valuable electronic components useful for constructing hacking devices.

name: Incriminating Phone Logs
description: An external hard drive containing phone communication data collected from Midnight Sapphire and the surrounding area. The data includes phone numbers and incriminating SMS messages exchanged by foreign visitors.

name: Iron Sucrose
description: An iron complex used to replenish the body's iron stores and support the production of hemoglobin and red blood cells. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: LAF Artillery Data Log
description: An external hard drive containing ballistic solution logs extracted from LAF artillery computers. The data reveals details about the LAF arsenal and indications that civilians were deliberately targeted on multiple occasions.

name: Laser Tube
description: A device containing a crystal and optical components designed to generate and direct light into a narrow, concentrated beam. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Mechanical Pipette
description: A mechanical pipette that makes laboratory work faster, safer, and more precise. No more sucking chemicals into a glass pipette by mouth. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Microscope
description: A precision optical instrument used to observe and work with components too small to be seen clearly by the naked eye. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Military Software
description: A USB drive containing specialized military software, including targeting solutions, personnel tracking tools, and other applications, along with a selection of classified data. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Missile Guidance Circuit
description: A guidance circuit extracted from an air-to-air missile at Fort Narith. Highly valuable on the black market.

name: Missile Seeker Head
description: An optical seeker from an air-to-air missile at Fort Narith. Contains valuable electronic components.

name: Multi-Bus Converter
description: An industrial-grade serial communication adapter designed to bridge different hardware communication protocols. An essential for constructing a basic hacking tool.

name: Multimeter
description: A versatile diagnostic tool used to measure voltage, current, and resistance when testing and troubleshooting electrical circuits. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Opium Gum
description: A sticky, gum-like substance collected by scoring poppy seedpods. An essential raw material for opiate production.

name: Oscilloscope
description: A specialized electronic instrument used to visualize and analyze electrical signals as they change over time. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: PC Fan
description: A cooling fan taken from a PC. Surprisingly dustless. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Phon Chai Farm Shed Key
description: A key to storage shed at Phon Chai Farm.

name: Power Supply
description: A computer component that converts electrical power and supplies the appropriate voltages to the system's internal components. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Purified Water
description: Water purified through boiling and condensation to remove impurities. Not intended for consumption, but ideal for use in opiate production.

name: RAM
description: Random-access memory used to temporarily store data for quick access by the processor. Generally, the more you have, the better. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Saline
description: A sterile saline solution with a variety of laboratory and medical applications, including wound cleaning, nasal rinsing, and contamination control. It also serves as a suitable base for morphine solutions.

name: Server CPU
description: A specialized processing unit designed to handle a large number of simultaneous processing threads. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Signal Generator
description: A device capable of accurately generating a wide range of electrical signal waveforms. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Silicone Sealant
description: An aquarium-grade silicone sealant resistant to water and a wide range of chemicals. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Soldering Iron
description: A handheld tool used to melt solder, allowing electrical components and connections to be joined together. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Spoofing ASIC Module
description: A specialized electronic module built around an application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC), designed to emulate, override, and spoof nearby wireless signatures and reproduce signal handshakes. An essential component for constructing a basic hacking tool.

name: Stainless Steel Sheet
description: A sheet of stainless steel resistant to most common corrosive chemicals. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Theophylline
description: A methylxanthine compound with stimulant and bronchodilatory properties, capable of increasing central nervous system activity while relaxing smooth muscle in the airways. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: Tooling Coolant
description: A specialized coolant used to reduce heat and friction during precision machining. Essential for accurate and reliable tooling operations. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: UN Medical Tools
description: A box containing select surgical tools, pills, and materials. It is an emergency health pack provided to UN employees.

name: UNLRA Relief Manifest
description: An external hard drive containing sensitive UNLRA communication logs, evacuation data, and operational protocols.

name: Vapor Lamp
description: A vapor lamp that emits light within a very narrow spectral range, making it a useful light source for high precision analysis. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Water Pump
description: A small powered device designed to move liquids from one place to another. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Zinc Electrode
description: A zinc electrode that serves as a source of zinc atoms during the galvanization process. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.
